# formal_org_theme (Resource)

The organization's display name and logo, shown to its users in the Catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The organization's display name and logo, shown to its users in the Catalog at
# catalog.formal.ai.
resource "formal_org_theme" "this" {
  display_name      = "Acme"
  logo              = filebase64("${path.module}/logo.svg")
  logo_content_type = "image/svg+xml"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The name shown in the Catalog header and browser tab. At most 60 characters.
- `logo` (String) The base64-encoded logo shown in place of the Formal mark and as the favicon, for example `filebase64("logo.svg")`. Must be square, at most 256 KiB.
- `logo_content_type` (String) The image type of `logo`. One of `image/svg+xml`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, `image/jpeg`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the theme was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the theme.
- `updated_at` (String) When the theme was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization has one theme. Import it with the ID that GetOrgTheme returns.
terraform import formal_org_theme.this <theme_id>
```
